core.item: ESP32 dev board (x2, one per hand)
core.product: Freenove ESP32 Development Board ESP32 Kit (2 Pack)
core.notes: One 2-pack covers both hands ($13.98/board). ESP32-WROOM, 4.4* (527), well documented.

core.product: Deegoo-FPV MG996R Metal Gear Digital Servo, 4-Pack
core.notes: 12 metal-gear standard servos, ~12 kg-cm @6V, $8.81/ea, 4.5* (1,182). Fits stock InMoov forearm. Showed 'only 6 left' - fallback: Aideepen MG996R 6-pack x2 (see Alternatives).
Adafruit-layout clone, works with Adafruit PWM library on ESP32. One board per hand matches 1-ESP32-per-hand; a single board (16 ch) could drive all 10 servos but would tie both hands to one ESP32.

core.item: Servo power supply (x2, one per hand)
core.product: SHNITPWR 3.5-12V Adjustable 10A 120W Power Supply w/ LCD
core.notes: Set to 6V. 10A = 5 MG996R running + 2-3 stalled (~2.5A stall each). LCD guards against accidental 12V. 4.3* (216). Servos NEVER on ESP32 5V pin; tie grounds.

core.product: 20 PCS Female DC 5.5x2.1mm Barrel to Screw Terminal
core.notes: Connects PSU to PCA9685 V+ terminal. Small jacks run warm near 10A - cutting the plug and screwing wire in is safer.
InMoov-class braid, low stretch; 100m is far more than both hands need. 4.5* (7.7K). Price for 50lb/100m variant.

core.product: Swpeet 150pc Stainless Extension Spring Assortment (15 sizes x 10)
core.notes: 10 of each size, so 10 matching springs per size for 10 fingers, lets you tune return force. 4.6* (111).

core.product: ELEGOO 120pc 20cm Dupont Wire (40 M-F / 40 M-M / 40 F-F)
core.notes: Signal/I2C wiring ESP32<->PCA9685. 4.7* (14.8K). One kit covers both hands.
Forearm servos to PCA9685 headers. Free shipping but slow (est. Oct 20-Nov 9); Prime alt in Alternatives.
18AWG handles the 10A servo bus; Dupont wire (24AWG) must not carry servo power. 4.5* (438).

optional.item: Fingertip force sensors (x2, proof of concept)
optional.notes: One per hand (e.g. index finger) on an ESP32 ADC pin via 10k divider. Qty-1 price break $10.43; qty 10 drops to $9.02/ea ($90.19) if you want all fingertips. DigiKey shipping for small orders NOT verified (free over $100 CAD). Amazon clones have 1 review - avoid.

alternatives.product: Miuzei MG90S Metal Gear Micro Servo, 10-Pack
alternatives.notes: Saves $65.67 vs MG996R, but only ~2 kg-cm and micro size: needs a remixed (non-stock) InMoov forearm. 4.5* (784).
12 servos for $79.98. Fallback if Deegoo sells out. Price from search results page. 4.3* (123).
~20 kg-cm, stronger grip; $197.97 for 12 (+$92 vs core). Search results price. 4.6* (47).
One board can run all 10 servos, but then one ESP32 drives both hands. 4.3* (222).

alternatives.item: Power - ONE supply for both hands
alternatives.notes: Saves ~$34 but max ~5.75V (less torque), single point of failure, exposed mains terminals need a cover. Needs AC cord below. 4.5* (182).
Only with the single-PSU option. Search results price.
Only 4 per size - not enough matching springs for 10 fingers.
$9.02/ea at qty 10; one per fingertip on both hands.

phase2.title: Phase 2 - Life-size InMoov humanoid v1 (both arms on stock InMoov STLs + wheeled base)

items.item: ARM: Big arm servos (omoplate, shoulder, rotate, bicep x 2 arms)
items.product: DS5160 SSG 60 kg HV digital servo, 180deg variant (RC Toys Upgrade Haven Store, 4.9 stars, 471 sold)
items.notes: ALIEXPRESS, FLAGGED: Amazon.ca DS5160 listings are C$50-57 each (one visible at C$56.75), so 8 of them would take C$400-450 of the C$500 cap. AliExpress shows free shipping. Pick the 180deg variant, not 270. 58 kg-cm at 6 V / 70 kg-cm at 8.4 V, about 2.5x an HS-805BB. The price could be a first-order deal, so re-check it in the cart. Amazon.ca fallback: ANNIMOS 60KG B07KTSCN4J (194 ratings), ZOSKAY B07K48FQ1N (85), 2-pack B09JGBW9KZ. [verified-on-page (AliExpress item page, C$32.84, free shipping)]

items.item: ARM: Arm servo power (one per arm, set to 7.4 V)
items.notes: Same family as the hand PSUs you already own. Each one runs the 4 big servos of one arm. The worm joints hold their position with the power off, so only 1-2 servos load up at a time. Gael runs a single 6 V 40-60 A supply for the whole robot; splitting per arm means one supply can't brown out the whole robot. Alternative: Aclorol 5V 60A B07KC3KSHP at C$51.38 (verified on the search page), but it only reaches about 5.5 V. [price from the existing bom.json alternatives (earlier check), not re-verified today because Amazon.ca hides prices on a Santa Clara address]

items.product: DYWISHKEY 500pcs M3 M4 M5 304 stainless flat-head countersunk socket cap screws + nuts
items.notes: InMoov BOM calls for about 50x M3x20 and 50x M4x20 countersunk, plus M3 nuts. Check the kit goes up to 20 mm (the thesis lists 3 mm screws at 12/20/30/35 mm). This overlaps the phase2 'Hardware' line (LuKaiSen kit C$15.99); you can drop that kit's screws and keep only the heat-set inserts. [verified on the Amazon.ca search results page (C$35.47, 55 ratings)]

items.item: ARM: Spare 10k pots for the pot-relocation mod
items.notes: The first choice is to reuse each servo's own pot on an extension lead (Gael: cut the wires and splice in length, don't desolder at the PCB). Builders break these pots by over-rotating them, so spares are needed. The pot works as a voltage divider, so a 10k pot replacing a ~5k pot still works. Gael uses round pots (PivPotentioRound) and a square version exists; a WH148 needs a holder like Thingiverse thing:6923985 (shoulder, metal linear pot) or thing:1464929 (bicep, square pot). The listing title says 'Dual'; if it turns out to be dual-gang, use one gang. [verified on the Amazon.ca search results page (C$13.99); single vs dual gang not confirmed]

items.item: ARM: 6 mm BBs for the shoulder/rotate ball races
items.product: Lancer Tactical 0.20 g 6 mm BBs, 4000-round bag
items.notes: Per arm: PivCenter 27 + PivMit 31 + RotCenter 27 + RotMit 31 = 116 balls, so 232 for both arms. The classic InMoov arm needs no other ball bearings. Gael warns that some greases dissolve plastic BBs, so use PTFE/silicone grease only. Canadian Tire sells the same BBs for about the same price. [estimate (Amazon.ca hides the price for this delivery address)]

items.item: ARM: Servo extension leads (pot relocation + reaching the PCA9685)
items.notes: 3 relocated pots per arm need 25-35 cm leads, plus the 8 big servos need to reach the controller. Same SKU as the phase1 cart. [price from phase1 bom.json (earlier check)]

items.product: Self-tapping screw assortment incl. M3x12 and 3.5x16 mm (4 per big servo)
items.notes: InMoov BOM: about 100x M3x12 for small servos and about 50x M4x20 for large servos. Use a hardware store if that's cheaper. [estimate]

One M8x90 per shoulder-to-Clavi joint, plus the elbow and wrist axles (the wrist uses an 8 mm x 6 cm bolt). The InMoov BOM lists about 15x M8x100 for the whole robot. A hardware store is cheapest. [estimate]
Needed on the PivWorm/RotWorm and the ball races. Must not attack ABS/PLA or the plastic BBs. [estimate]

notes: Both arms C$452.30 pre-tax (cap C$500). Whole phase 2 C$1077.15; plus the hands cart (already bought) C$316.40.
Arm servos per arm: omoplate, rotate, bicep = DS5160 60 kg with the pot moved to the joint (Gael's mod); shoulder = DS5160 pot in place, limited 0-80; wrist + 5 fingers = owned MG996R.

DS5160 is the HS-805BB footprint (65x30 mm) but 10 mm shorter: expect a printed spacer under the tabs; test-fit one before printing everything. Exact drop-in is the PDI-HV2060MG (~C$54 each, would break the cap).
Removed vs round 3: 8x NFP 5840 worm motors, 8x BTS7960, 8x AS5600 (custom-arm parts that don't mount in InMoov STLs). The owned PCA9685s drive the arm servos.
